Event: Harby summit in Pellport. Host: Alba Garcroft. Budget: 33,250. Capacity: 165. Requirements: 10 breakout rooms.

Staff Changes: Leon out (Cora covers); Rafe out (Vik covers); Pia out (Ines covers); Bram out (Nils covers); Wren out (Cora covers); Ada out (Kira covers).

Desk Swaps: Finn/Hugo, Leon/Rafe, Opal/Bram, Wren/Greta, Greta/Ines, Mira/Greta, Teo/Dell, Ines/Hugo, Jonah/Leon, Ines/Una, Jonah/Rafe.

Room Preferences: Cora, Finn, Ada, Vik, Rafe keep Garden Studio/Loading Bay clear. Wren/Greta prefer Harbour. Bram/Nils want Garden Studio. Opal/Dell/Hugo want Loading Bay/Library. Suri wants North office. Leon wants East Wing. Opal wants East Wing kept clear for visitors.

Room Status: North office (repainting, noisy afternoon, coffee OK, umbrella, slow lift, cold evening). Library annex (repainting, noisy evening, coffee OK, umbrella, slow lift). Print room (cold, slow lift, repainting, umbrella). Garden studio (slow lift, umbrella, coffee working, noisy evening, cold afternoon). Loading bay (coffee OK, cold/evening issues, repainting, umbrella, slow lift). Harbour room (repainting, noisy evening/afternoon, slow lift, slow lift nearby). East Wing (cold afternoon, slow lift, coffee OK, umbrella).

Tasks: Send notes to Rafe, Wren, Cora, Greta, Suri, Nils, Hugo, Pia. Check with Cora (morning), Finn, Jonah (evening). Draft note to Bram. Send notes to Dell. Stand-ups: Morning to Print room, Afternoon to Harbour room, Evening to North office.

People: Involving: Ines, Finn, Mira, Ada, Greta, Leon, Dell. Una asked about availability. Opal asked about Loading Bay evening. Teo asked about Print room afternoon. Vik asked if Harbour room is free in the afternoon. Mira asked if Harbour room is free in the morning.

Updates: Mira thinks Print room is too cold in afternoon. Coffee machine in Library annex is working. Opal asked if East Wing is free in afternoon. Lift near Library annex is slow today. Una thinks the north office is too cold in the evening. Lift near the harbour room is slow today.
